title: in need of DevOps Engineer
description:
Looking for DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Freelancer to maintain and enhance our production systems and software.

Responsibilities:
-Manage and optimize our cloud and platform infrastructure using Azure and Kubernetes
-Automate deployments and infrastructure using CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, Helm)
-Monitor and maintain databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Weaviate)
-Ensure system stability through monitoring & observability with Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki
-Manage authentication and access control using KeyCloak
Work with NginX and Traefik for routing and load balancing
-Debug and resolve issues, while also developing minor features to enhance system functionality

Must-Have Skills:
-Cloud & Platform: Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, and container orchestration
-CI/CD: Proficiency in GitLab Pipelines (preferably with NX integration), GitHub, and Azure Pipelines
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience with Terraform and Helm
-Security & Access: Strong knowledge of VPN and SSH for connecting to customer systems
-Docker: Solid experience with containerization and service management
-Monitoring & Observability: Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki for system monitoring
-Databases: Strong expertise in MySQL, PostgreSQL

Nice-to-Have Skills:
-Experience with Weaviate as a vector database
-Familiarity with Azure Pipelines for CI/CD
